title: Puerto Rico and CAA 2023: The Consolidated Art of Postponing Adequate Funding.
description: On October 1, 2027, the Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2023 resets Puerto Rico's Medicaid cap as if eight years of federal support never happened: from roughly $4 billion a year to $500 million, with the federal match falling from 76% back to a statutory 55%. This episode takes CAA 2023 apart mechanism by mechanism - the open-ended matching the 50 states enjoy versus Puerto Rico's hard cap, the $19 billion five-year band-aid and the conditions the island met to unlock it, the CBO scoring logic that wrote a cliff into the same law, and the permanent 83% match Congress granted to every other U.S. territory. Projected fallout if nothing changes: $3.5 billion lost overnight, 48,000 jobs, and up to a million people without coverage.
